description: INTERNAL — the offer board calls this to refresh itself while vendors finish pricing. Never call this yourself. The board you were given is already final for its turn; do not reach for refine_quote to look at it again either, that paints a duplicate board. An offer's manufacturability_check (status checking → passed | repriced | failed, expected_s) means the price is set; the shop is confirming it can make the part as drawn; the board renders it.
